svg.text: hazard_detection — scoreboards, stall and counter update
Stall (none while stall_outside): [rs1]≠0 for a branch or jump that reads a register (valid_bit and RF1 or RF2, no MEM->ID path); [rs1]>1 for
RF1 and [rs2]>1 for RF2 (a load or multiply one ahead); SP[rs2]≠0 for movs2i (SP_read); shift_bit and not mul_or_not (the multiplier's result
takes the write-back port next cycle). Update, when not stalled: SP_write writes SP[rd] = 2; else WF1 writes G[rd] = 2 for a load or
multiply, 1 otherwise, and a multiply sets shift_bit. All counters count down; rst or special_pc_sel clears them.
